Openplanet Plugin Development 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides an overview and best practices for creating and structuring folder-based Openplanet AngelScript plugins.
- Documents essential entry points, plugin metadata (`info.toml`), and setting definitions.
- Details critical API quirks and common pitfalls (e.g., case sensitivity, UI functions, time handling).
- Includes debugging tips for compilation errors and log file usage.
- Presents patterns for calendar calculations and recurring weekly events in Trackmania/Maniaplanet plugins.
- Compatible with Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
